title: Settings
push_on: This phone gets push notifications for mentions, assignments and other notices.
push_denied: Notifications are off. Turn them on in the system settings.
push_ask_hint: Get push notifications for mentions and conversations assigned to you.
sign_out_body: This phone will stop getting notifications.
delete_body: Your account is closed, every session ends and you cannot sign in again. Your organizations keep their data.
presence_hint: Automatic routing only gives new conversations to available agents.
prefs_push_hint: When off, no phone gets pushes for this account.
setup_start: Set up your organization with AI or a ready template in 2 minutes. The set-up opens on the web panel.
setup_draft: Your set-up plan is waiting for review.
setup_applying: Your organization is being set up…
setup_applied: The smart set-up was applied. Review what was created on the web panel; you can undo it for 24 hours.
name: First name
live_activities_hint: Ongoing calls and conversations about to breach their SLA appear on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
live_activities_failed: Couldn't save the setting. Check your connection and try again.
widgets_add_ios: Touch and hold an empty area of the Home Screen, tap + at the top left and choose ClickFix. The Lock Screen and Control Center galleries list ClickFix too.
widgets_add_android: Touch and hold an empty area of the Home Screen, tap Widgets and choose ClickFix.
